name: Panasonic eneloop AAA Rechargeable Batteries with BQ-CC17 Charger
summary: Four standard white AAA NiMH cells and a BQ-CC17 AC charger for compatible smaller devices. Already own this charger? Compare separate AAA cells before buying another starter kit.
description: This AAA starter kit serves smaller battery compartments without substituting the larger AA format. Four standard white eneloop cells accompany the BQ-CC17, which can also charge compatible AA eneloop cells purchased separately. Prepare and label spare sets before an outage, then rotate them according to actual device use. If a BQ-CC17 is already part of your equipment, purchasing AAA cells alone may avoid paying for a duplicate charger. The kit contains four cells and one charger; the additional cells and 850 mAh label in the illustration do not establish package quantity or the capacity of the supplied revision.

specs.label: Kit
specs.value: Four standard white AAA eneloop NiMH cells and one BQ-CC17 charger; K-KJ17M3A4BA

specs.label: Capacity
specs.value: Up to 800 mAh / minimum 750 mAh; the illustration’s 850 mAh is not confirmed for this kit; manufacturer capacity convention, not measured runtime

specs.label: Charger
specs.value: BQ-CC17, individually controlled slots for 1–4 compatible AA/AAA eneloop NiMH cells

specs.label: AC input
specs.value: 100–240 V AC; regional plug varies. Not a USB or solar-input charger.

specs.label: Charge
specs.value: About 6 hours for 1–4 AAA cells in the 750–800 mAh band at room temperature; temperature and cell condition affect time

specs.label: Cycles
specs.value: Up to 2100 under IEC 61951-2:2011 (7.5.1.3); 600 under IEC 61951-2:2017 (7.5.1.4). Usage conditions affect life.

pros: The smaller AAA format suits devices specifically designed to accept 1.2 V NiMH AAA cells.
The same BQ-CC17 charger can serve compatible AA and AAA eneloop sets.
cons: Use only in devices whose instructions accept AAA 1.2 V NiMH cells; size alone is insufficient.
The BQ-CC17 needs AC power and takes about 6 hours in the documented capacity band; it is not an instant outage recharge source.
An existing BQ-CC17 may make a second kit unnecessary. The illustration’s 850 mAh is not verified for the selected kit revision.
useCases: Prepare spare AAA sets for compatible compact lights and household devices.
Share an existing BQ-CC17 across compatible AA and AAA sets rather than automatically buying two chargers.

safetyNotes: Charge only compatible rechargeable NiMH cells in the BQ-CC17. Do not charge alkaline, primary lithium or lithium-ion cells. Follow polarity markings and the supplied instructions.
Keep the charger dry, ventilated and on an appropriate indoor AC supply. Inspect cells and charger for damage; discontinue use if damaged or abnormal.
Store spare cells with protected terminals away from loose metal. Follow device instructions for matched cells and do not mix damaged, depleted or incompatible cells.
AA and AAA are different sizes. Neither kit establishes compatibility with ORIA, a particular radio or an emergency light; check its voltage and chemistry requirements.
